# Ada 4.0.0 amalgamated release

The upstream v4.0.0 release was published on 2026-07-27. The unmodified `ada.h` and `ada.cpp`
assets were downloaded from the release on 2026-11-17 and checked against the task's SHA-256 pins.
The unmodified `LICENSE-APACHE` from that tag is stored as `LICENSE`. This copy uses Apache-2.0.
Run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` in this directory to verify the assets and notice.
[Upstream release](https://github.com/ada-url/ada/releases/tag/v4.0.0)
